name: Agency Bulk Upload — Daily Intake
description: Daily agency intake. Fires once per day per onboarded agency at 12:00 America/Chicago. If the agency has NOT uploaded today, one human task reaches out (call / sms / email) and the branch ends. If it HAS uploaded, the object model is updated end to end: AI extraction (regex + Gemini) with a human fallback on extraction failure, patient resolve (create vs update), admission date-gap fill then resolve, episode date-gap fill then resolve, order create vs skip-duplicate, and a final human review that settles the item. No RCM / AI-service / audit / rework steps (phase 2).

groups.name: Contact Agency to Upload Documents
groups.info: Agency has not uploaded today — reach out (call / SMS placeholders + a real email). This branch ends the item.

groups.name: Update Object Module
groups.info: Agency uploaded — build the object model end to end: AI extraction (regex + Gemini) with a human fallback, patient resolve (update vs create), admission date-gap fill then resolve, episode date-gap fill then resolve, order create vs skip-duplicate, then a final human review that settles the item.

nodes.name: Check agency uploaded today
nodes.description: Look at uploaded_documents for this agency on today's day bucket; stamps agency_uploaded / agency_not_uploaded.

nodes.name: Contact agency to upload the documents
nodes.description: Agency has not uploaded today. Reach out (call / sms are coming-soon placeholders; email is a real send). Branch ends here.

nodes.name: AI extract (regex + Gemini)
nodes.description: Cost-tiered extraction: regex tier then Gemini for any still-missing fields. Merges into the item payloads; stamps ai_extraction_success / ai_extraction_fail.

nodes.name: Manually fill missing data
nodes.description: Extraction could not fill enough fields — a coordinator fills the missing patient/order values before the object-model writes.

nodes.name: Update patient
nodes.description: Patient unit found by name + dob + mrn — update the existing unit/record.

nodes.name: Create patient
nodes.description: No patient unit found — create the Patient Unit + Patient Record.

nodes.name: Enter admission dates
nodes.description: SOC (and EOC) are missing — a coordinator enters them so the admission row is written with real dates.

nodes.name: Check / create admission
nodes.description: Resolve the admission by patient + SOC — reuse if it exists, else create it.

nodes.name: Enter episode dates
nodes.description: SOE/EOE are missing — a coordinator enters them so the episode row is written with real dates.

nodes.name: Check / create episode
nodes.description: Resolve the episode within the admission by SOE/EOE — reuse if it exists, else create it.

nodes.name: Skip duplicate order
nodes.description: Order number already exists — leave the existing order untouched and mark this row a skipped duplicate.

nodes.name: Create order
nodes.description: New order number — write the order row attached to the resolved admission/episode.

nodes.name: Review record
nodes.description: Coordinator reviews the assembled patient/admission/episode/order and confirms the checklist. Completing this settles the item.
